errors.text: The mechanism incorrectly implies that the MTP itself must model the DOS-gap electronic-excitation contribution. In the target approach, the electronic Gibbs-energy correction is a distinct physical contribution and cannot generally be inferred from an ordinary position-dependent MTP unless electronic temperature is explicitly represented in its training.

FEP is described as directly calculating the solid-liquid free-energy difference, whereas its key role is to evaluate the small MTP-to-DFT free-energy correction within adequately sampled phase ensembles.
